title: paguro Windows API
description: The one API of the Windows side (INTERFACES.md §11.7): JSON-RPC 2.0 over the named pipe \\.\pipe\paguro, one message per line (UTF-8, LF, at most 4 MiB). `methods` names every method with its access, CLI command, cmdlets, params and result; `$defs` holds the types. Rust (crates/paguro-win/src/rpc.rs) is checked against this file by tests/api_contract.rs; the C# types are generated from it (windows/api/codegen). A method's `params` are its own plus `$defs/CommonParams`. Errors: code -32000 - exit (JSON.md), data per `$defs/ErrorData`; a missing secret is data.data per `$defs/NeedsInput`.

x-access.read: anyone the pipe admits (the interactive user)
x-access.admin: a member of Administrators, elevated or not
